fields.description: An international standard for geographic information metadata.

fields.description: A standard for describing sensors and sensor systems.

fields.name: INSPIRE EF

fields.name: Dublin Core
fields.description: A set of vocabulary terms used to describe web resources.

fields.name: EML
fields.description: Ecological Metadata Language (EML) is a metadata standard developed for the ecology discipline.

fields.name: schema.org
fields.description: A collaborative, community activity with a mission to create, maintain, and promote schemas for structured data on the Internet.

fields.name: FGDC
fields.description: Federal Geographic Data Committee (FGDC) is responsible for coordinating the development of the National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI).

fields.name: DCAT-AP
fields.description: DCAT Application Profile for data portals in Europe (DCAT-AP) is a specification based on DCAT for describing public sector datasets in Europe.
